encryption_details.algorithm: Two schemes. (1) File data: custom 10-round substitution cipher using the standard AES S-box (copied to .rdata:0x14000a120): for r=0..9 { for i=0..15: b[i] = SBOX[b[i]] ^ key[i] ^ (27*r) } applied to 16-byte blocks (function 0x1400014c3), over the first min(filesize, 0x100000) bytes; result written back in place and file renamed to <name>.WNCRY. (2) Strings: repeating-byte XOR (function 0x14000156b: buf[i] ^= key[i % keylen]).
encryption_details.key: File cipher key: "W@nCryPt0K3y2024" (16 ASCII bytes at .rdata:0x14000a100). String XOR key: DE AD BE EF 13 37 CA FE (8 raw bytes at .rdata:0x14000a220), passed as (key,len=8) to the XOR routine.
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys are hardcoded plaintext constants in the read-only .rdata section (no key derivation, no key exchange). A decoy/fake RSA public-key DER blob (30 82 01 0A 02 82 01 01 00 ...) sits at .rdata:0x14000a000.

injection_details.process_injection: None. No VirtualAllocEx/WriteProcessMemory/CreateRemoteThread/NtMapViewOfSection/QueueUserAPC imports or dynamic resolution; VirtualProtect/VirtualQuery present only via the mingw pseudo-relocation runtime. Persistence/execution is achieved with a Windows service (CreateServiceA "mssecsvc2.0", binary path = GetModuleFileNameA of self, SERVICE_WIN32_OWN_PROCESS | SERVICE_AUTO_START, then StartServiceA).
